title: Highly Recommended
text: Totally fantastic day out! Very well organised, we felt looked after every step of the way. Highly recommended!
author: 593melanieb

title: An amazing experience all around
text: This was such a fun day and event. From our experience which included the e-bikes to the winery and boat sailing back to Barcelona city, the team was extremely kind and professional. Our captain Luigi was also so much fun and ensured we had the best day on the water. He even ensured we were able to swim when we asked.
author: Michael_G

title: Barcelona sailing and wine
text:
All aspects of this excursion are enjoyable. We traveled to the vineyard by van from Barcelona. The staff at the vineyard are knowledgeable and very pleasant. The wines are very good. The sea was a little rough, the captain did his best to steer us in calm waters. 
The other tour members were a blast.
author: gordon_m

title: Great adventure!
text:
So much fun! Our guide Stefano was wonderful! The bike ride was beautiful, wine  was delicious and the sail back was great! 
We took our teenage daughter and even though she couldn’t  wine taste she had a great time riding the bike, seeing all the beaches and sailing! Wine tasting was just a small portion of this adventure if you have teens that might need to join you.
author: Sheri_H

title: A Wonderful Day
text: It was a wonderful day. Wonderful views, lovely people, and a gorgeous sail back to Barcelona!  The wine was also pretty amazing too!
author: Elizabeth_J

title: Perfect Day
text: This was a very nice excursion which started with a van ride to the town of Alella for a short walk to the Bouquet d’Alella Vineyards. This beautiful 5 generation family owned vineyard has great wines, esp. the Syrah. After the tour and wine tasting with cheeses and meats, we headed to the water and enjoyed a 1 1/2 hour sailboat ride back to Port Olympic. Very relaxing. Would highly recommend.
author: Trish B

title: A Relaxing Escape with Stunning Views and Great Wine!
text: I joined this sailing and wine-tasting experience during my visit to Barcelona, and it was absolutely fantastic! The vineyard was breathtaking, and the wine selection was perfect for the occasion. As someone visiting from the U.S., I love traveling with my essentials, and my Delta 8 vape from Delta 8 Wholesale added an extra layer of relaxation to the whole experience. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to unwind and enjoy the beauty of Barcelona!
author: deltawholesale8

title: E-bike, Winery & Sailing
text:
We had PERFECT weather.  Tour guides were WONDERFUL Hosts.  The Experience was a DELIGHT.

However, Viator should put "e-bike" in the Title of the Tour & describe the distance/difficulty of the riding terrain in the details as we were NOT prepared.
